diagnosis.description: Root cause of the main handling problem, in two to four sentences, citing the readings and complaints that support it.

data_quality_flags.description: Reasons the data is weaker than it looks. Empty when there are none.

adjustments.description: Pressure corrections first (priority 0, source MATH), then one primary change (priority 1) and up to three secondary changes (priority 2-4).

priority.description: 0 for calculator pressure corrections, 1 for the primary change, 2-4 for secondary changes.

scope.description: One wheel, both wheels on an axle, or the whole car.

suggested_value.description: Absolute new value, within min/max and on the step grid from setup.adjustable.

addresses.description: The complaint or reading this change targets, e.g. 'entry oversteer at T1' or 'FR hot pressure 1.7 psi high'.

rationale.description: Why this change fixes it, in one or two sentences.

expected_tradeoff.description: Net effect of the whole package on the car's behaviour.

next_stint_focus.description: What the driver should pay attention to and what data to record on the next run.

unavailable_fixes.description: Changes that would help but are not adjustable on this car. Empty when there are none.
